split_extension.description: Recordings present in manifest.csv but absent from the frozen dataset_split deliverable get a split here. Existing assignments are never modified.
split_extension.source_group_rule: parent recording_id if parent_filepath is set, else recording_id (same rule as dataset_split)
split_extension.method: per canonical_category x device stratum, largest-duration-first greedy assignment to the split with the largest absolute duration deficit; ties broken by sha256(seed|source_group|split)
split_extension.device_note: Device (Macmic / Phonemic / RPI) is parsed from manual-recording filenames only to stratify; source_group remains recording_id, consistent with dataset_split.

asr.decode_unit_rationale: Decoding whole 25-60 s recordings of repeated 'Hey Delta' produced repetition loops with zero-length word timestamps; decoding each VAD speech chunk independently does not. Short clips (<= whole_file_max_sec) are decoded whole because Silero VAD misses or clips quiet onsets in them.
asr.model_note: large-v3 recovered 28/71 short real clips vs ~21 for 'small' in a pilot on this corpus; many RPI clips are at -46..-50 dBFS RMS and remain unrecognised by either model (they are flagged for human review).
asr.peak_normalize_note: Disabled: in a pilot, peak normalisation changed transcripts in both directions with no net gain.

boundary_refinement.note: Deterministic energy snapping of ASR word bounds (see refine_bounds). Output stays an ASR candidate; raw Whisper bounds are kept in raw_start_sec/raw_end_sec. Parameters chosen by a sweep that kept the TTS calibration requirement low while giving plausible (~0.8 s median) spans on real recordings; a global noise floor extended real spans into room background.

synthetic_ground_truth.streaming_eval: wakeword_metadata insertion start_sec/end_sec are used verbatim.

tts_positive_whole_clip.description: Each TTS positive clip is one complete, ASR-verified 'Hey Delta' utterance generated in isolation. The ground truth is clip-level; the span is the clip trimmed of leading/trailing near-silence by a deterministic energy rule (no ASR involved).

asr_unreviewed_positive_policy_options.allow_flagged: ASR 'complete' candidates that pass quality gates may produce positive windows, labelled label_source=asr_candidate_unreviewed.
asr_unreviewed_positive_policy_options.require_review: ASR candidates produce positives only after a confirm_complete review override.

boundary_tolerance_sec.note: Applied as [start - pre, end + post]. verified_bounds = synthetic GT, human-added, or human-corrected bounds; ASR bounds keep their tolerance even after confirm_complete. Calibrated on outputs/asr_boundary_calibration.json (energy-trimmed TTS positives): raw Whisper word ends were up to 0.51 s early (median 0.35 s); energy-refined bounds need pre 0.08 / post 0.38. validate_windows.py fails if a tolerance is below the requirement in the current calibration. The calibration uses synthetic speech; real-recording error is unmeasured until reviewed bounds exist.

window.duration_rationale: Matches clip_len_sec=1.5 used for every fixed-length clip already in the corpus.
window.output_sample_rate_rationale: Only used by 'materialize'. Headers show 1,249 manifest rows are 16/22.05/24 kHz although manifest.csv lists 48 kHz (all TTS positives and confusables). Exporting every window at 16 kHz removes a bandwidth cue that would otherwise separate band-limited TTS positives from full-band negatives.

positive.rule: A window is positive iff it fully contains [start - tol_pre, end + tol_post] of exactly one positive-eligible annotation (match_type=complete, status in {ground_truth, candidate, reviewed}, origin allowed by asr_unreviewed_positive_policy), with at least min_pre_context_sec before and min_post_context_sec after, and overlaps no other non-removed wakeword-like annotation (also tolerance-expanded).
positive.fallback_note: Used only when the tolerance-expanded span fits in the window with both minimum margins but none of the post_roll offsets does; yields at most one extra window per occurrence.

partial_negative.rationale: Fragment windows need accurate wakeword bounds to guarantee the rest of the wakeword is excluded; unverified ASR bounds do not qualify.
partial_negative.exclude_note: human_clip_extent spans ([0, duration] from a clip_level_positive override) contain the wakeword but are not tight: a 35% 'fragment' of the clip could hold the whole word, so no fragments are cut from them.

negative.max_windows_note: Raised from 120 to 700 on 2026-09-28 when Manual-BG-RPI16..19 (up to 473 s) were added: at 120 the longest kept ~38% of its audio. Only these recordings reached the cap. Dominance of one recording is handled by the training sampler's source-group weighting (dataloading, weight ~ n_windows^-0.5).

_hold_recordings: Recordings listed here produce no windows (logged as held_recording) and get no owner rows until released by removing them from this list after their timings are added.
